title: Add a headless internet relay for native lockstep peers behind NAT
detail: Implement a headless relay process that forwards the existing lockstep wire v1 reliable-channel messages without observing or running the simulation; retain direct ENet as the LAN path and prove reconnect plus an 8-seat 30-minute zero-desync run through the relay.
oracle: scripted eight-peer internet-relay harness: 30 simulated minutes, zero desyncs, reconnect succeeds, replay bytes identical
